stepExplanation:
Using conservation of momentum:
$$m_1u_1 + m_2u_2 = m_1v_1 + m_2v_2$$
$$(2)(6) + (4)(0) = (2)(-2) + (4)(v_2)$$
$$12 + 0 = -4 + 4v_2$$
$$12 + 4 = 4v_2$$
$$16 = 4v_2$$
$$v_2 = 4 \text{ m/s}$$
The 4 kg ball moves at 4 m/s in the original direction of the 2 kg ball.
stepBody: Using conservation of momentum with m₁ = 2 kg, u₁ = 6 m/s, m₂ = 4 kg, u₂ = 0, v₁ = -2 m/s, find v₂. Give your answer in m/s.
